title: Every UEFA Nations League Winner 🏆 England Have Never Won It #shorts
description:
Every UEFA Nations League winner since the competition began: Portugal beat the Netherlands 1–0 in Porto in 2019, France beat Spain 2–1 in Milan in 2021, Spain beat Croatia on penalties in Rotterdam in 2023, and Portugal beat Spain on penalties in Munich in 2025. Portugal are the only two-time winners; England's best finish is third in 2019. The Nations League returns this week with England vs Croatia and Italy vs France.

title: Longest Point Streaks in NHL History: Gretzky 51 🤯 McDavid Chasing #shorts
description:
The longest point streaks in NHL history: Wayne Gretzky's 51 games for the Edmonton Oilers in 1983–84 (61 goals and 92 assists), Mario Lemieux's 46 games for the Pittsburgh Penguins in 1989–90, Mats Sundin's 30, and 28-game runs by Paul Coffey, Guy Lafleur and Steve Yzerman. Connor McDavid has a point in all 19 Oilers games this season (as of 11 Nov 2026) and goes for 20 against the Philadelphia Flyers.
